name: glide
description: Browser-only Screen Studio: Chrome MV3 extension that records a tab/window/screen + mic + webcam and exports polished MP4 with cursor-follow zoom.

scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../glide-extension.zip .
scripts.test:record: npm run build && SURFACE=monitor HEADFUL=1 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1920x1080x24' node test/record-smoke.mjs
